summary: Read-only interface foundation for @seis, @seis-cloud, @seis-code, @seis-design, and @seis-data with a five-year development horizon.

interfaces.title: SEIS Command Layer
interfaces.purpose: Coordinate repository governance, goals, evidence, and Command Center navigation from one source-of-truth surface.
interfaces.currentSurface: Command Center lane status and Goal Tracking OS records.
interfaces.nextAction: Keep official docs, status, backlog, and generated static views aligned before expanding live controls.

interfaces.title: Cloud Readiness
interfaces.purpose: Expose deployment readiness, cloud checks, remote workspace boundaries, and blocked live actions without executing deployment.
interfaces.currentSurface: Dry-run cloud readiness and publish-gate evidence.
interfaces.nextAction: Add target-provider review, rollback evidence, and SSH-disabled-by-default runbook before live actions.

interfaces.title: SEIS Code Workspace
interfaces.purpose: Define the browser IDE, virtual file system, terminal, source-control simulation, and no-key AI REPL boundaries.
interfaces.currentSurface: Static MVP contract and code automation plan evidence.
interfaces.nextAction: Implement a small browser-safe file explorer and editor slice before adding Monaco or terminal dependencies.

interfaces.title: Design System
interfaces.purpose: Track tokens, components, accessibility, reduced motion, visual QA, and asset provenance as design infrastructure.
interfaces.nextAction: Add component inventory, visual QA checklist, and reduced-motion acceptance evidence for each product surface.

interfaces.title: Data And Evidence
interfaces.purpose: Manage JSON records, evidence ledgers, generated reports, freshness rules, and data contracts for SEIS surfaces.
interfaces.currentSurface: Goal records, evidence records, data package, and generated view models.
interfaces.nextAction: Create a schema registry and freshness policy for current JSON records before analytics expansion.

fiveYearHorizon.focus: Static read-only interfaces, status matrix, backlog, evidence links, and no-live-action boundaries.
fiveYearHorizon.validation: Static syntax checks, JSON validation, manual accessibility review.

fiveYearHorizon.focus: Shared navigation, lane dashboards, local persistence, search, and operator review workflows.
fiveYearHorizon.validation: Component tests, keyboard QA, data freshness checks.

fiveYearHorizon.focus: Read-only GitHub, cloud dry-run, SEIS Code MVP, design inventory, and data schema coverage.
fiveYearHorizon.validation: Contract tests, no-key startup checks, redacted provider audits.

fiveYearHorizon.focus: Approval-gated actions, audit trails, agent task queues, policy-aware AI assistance, and rollback-ready operations.
fiveYearHorizon.validation: Permission tests, audit event reviews, fallback and degraded-mode checks.

fiveYearHorizon.focus: Multi-workspace federation, public-readiness packs, release governance, local model options, and long-term maintenance cadence.
fiveYearHorizon.validation: Release dry-runs, public exposure review, security baseline refresh, long-term roadmap review.

developmentProgram.operatingPosture: Read-only, validator-backed, and safe without cloud credentials.

laneCommitments.focus: Unify source-of-truth navigation, status, backlog, and evidence into one Command Center lane.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: A stable governance surface for repository state, goals, and current safe actions.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Status, backlog, index, and plugin roadmap validators remain green.

laneCommitments.focus: Keep cloud and SSH controls visibly approval-gated while documenting dry-run readiness.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Cloud lane shows readiness blockers, rollback needs, and disabled live actions.
laneCommitments.validationGate: No live deployment, SSH, or credential path is exposed in the browser.

laneCommitments.focus: Define the browser IDE contract before adding heavy runtime dependencies.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: SEIS Code lane links to the editor, file-system, terminal, and no-key AI REPL contract.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Code workspace remains planned until a browser-safe editor/file slice is validated.

laneCommitments.focus: Treat design tokens, accessibility, motion, and component quality as governance inputs.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Design lane exposes quality gates and component inventory requirements.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Reduced-motion, mobile readability, and token evidence stay documented.

laneCommitments.focus: Register current JSON records and make freshness, provenance, and validator coverage visible.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Data lane shows schema-registry work and evidence-backed records.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Schema registry and roadmap validators verify the referenced records.

developmentProgram.operatingPosture: Local-first workflows with shared navigation, persistence, and operator review loops.

laneCommitments.focus: Promote the plugin lane system into the main Command Center information architecture.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Operators can move between goals, docs, evidence, and lane-specific actions from one shell.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Keyboard navigation, route persistence, and source links pass browser QA.

laneCommitments.focus: Add cloud target review screens without executing deployment or SSH commands.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Cloud readiness shows target, environment, rollback, and approval status.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Dry-run data is labeled and live actions remain disabled until approved.

laneCommitments.focus: Ship the first local file explorer, editor, and command-history slice.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: SEIS Code can edit local virtual files and persist sessions without provider keys.
laneCommitments.validationGate: No-key startup, save/reopen, and mobile layout checks pass.

laneCommitments.focus: Turn component inventory into a reusable review surface for SEIS product pages.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Design lane tracks component status, accessibility notes, and visual QA needs.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Component inventory JSON and visual QA notes stay linked from the interface.

laneCommitments.focus: Add freshness metadata and evidence expiration rules for Command Center records.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Data lane can explain whether each record is current, stale, mock, or blocked.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Freshness checks distinguish stale evidence from current validation.

developmentProgram.operatingPosture: Read-only integrations first, contract-tested before write-gated actions.

laneCommitments.focus: Connect repository governance, reviews, goals, and release readiness into one evidence model.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Command lane shows cross-lane dependencies and review sequence without hidden state.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Contract tests verify status inputs before any live write path is enabled.

laneCommitments.focus: Introduce read-only provider status, environment comparison, and deployment package review.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Cloud lane can compare intended and observed deployment readiness without deploying.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Provider status uses sanitized data and keeps credentials server-only.

laneCommitments.focus: Add Monaco-backed editing, browser terminal foundations, and safe source-control simulation.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Code lane becomes a working local development cockpit for repository-friendly tasks.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Editor persistence, command behavior, and no-secret bundle scans pass.

laneCommitments.focus: Link design tokens, component QA, motion rules, and asset provenance to product surfaces.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Design lane can identify which surfaces need visual, motion, or accessibility review.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Accessibility and reduced-motion checks are part of the release evidence pack.

laneCommitments.focus: Expand schema coverage for goals, evidence, quality signals, providers, and interface records.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Data lane becomes the contract source for Command Center dashboards.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Data-schema registry covers every UI-consumed JSON file.

developmentProgram.operatingPosture: Approval-gated actions, audit trails, and policy-aware automation only.

laneCommitments.focus: Coordinate human approval queues, agent task boundaries, and rollback-ready change plans.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Command lane distinguishes recommended, approved, blocked, and completed actions.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Approval and audit records exist before any write-gated operation.

laneCommitments.focus: Add deployment dry-run comparison, rollback drills, and cloud incident evidence views.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Cloud lane supports controlled release review without autonomous production changes.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Deployment actions require explicit approval and rollback notes.

laneCommitments.focus: Introduce Claude-style local demo REPL tools and backend-gated live AI routing where configured.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Code lane can run safe virtual commands and clearly label actual provider identity.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Local-only mode, tool permissions, and fallback identity checks pass.

laneCommitments.focus: Automate non-destructive design QA summaries while preserving human visual review.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Design lane produces review queues for contrast, layout, motion, and content fit.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Automated findings are evidence-labeled and never override human approval.

laneCommitments.focus: Add audit-event, provenance, and validation-evidence ledgers for automated workflows.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Data lane can trace which record supported each visible recommendation.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Every automated status has evidence, timestamp, and stale-state rules.

developmentProgram.operatingPosture: Multi-workspace, release-ready, privacy-aware, and maintainable over the long run.

laneCommitments.focus: Stabilize the SEIS ecosystem operating model across repositories, goals, and release trains.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Command lane supports long-term governance, public readiness, and review cadence.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Release dry-runs and public readiness reviews support maturity claims.

laneCommitments.focus: Operate cloud and remote workspace readiness through auditable, least-privilege workflows.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Cloud lane shows deployment posture, remote workspace safety, and recovery evidence.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Security baseline refresh and incident-response review are current.

laneCommitments.focus: Maintain SEIS Code as a dependable browser workspace with local and approved live AI modes.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Code lane supports editor, terminal, extension, and AI-provider visibility at product quality.
laneCommitments.validationGate: No-key startup, bundle secret scans, and browser E2E remain part of release readiness.

laneCommitments.focus: Keep the design system coherent across Command Center, desktop, AI, data, and showcase surfaces.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Design lane becomes the durable quality record for visual, motion, and accessibility work.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Design review cadence and component quality gates remain documented.

laneCommitments.focus: Federate evidence, schemas, evaluations, and readiness records across mature SEIS workspaces.
laneCommitments.interfaceOutcome: Data lane supports public-ready status, release evidence, and long-term trend review.
laneCommitments.validationGate: Data provenance, freshness, and schema coverage are refreshed before releases.

periods.label: H1 build cycle
periods.purpose: Define, prototype, and validate the next safe interface slice for the selected year.
periods.reviewGate: Mid-year review must confirm evidence paths, mobile behavior, and no-key fallback before expansion.

periods.label: H2 hardening cycle
periods.purpose: Stabilize, document, and prepare the selected year's interface work for reviewable PR sequencing.
periods.reviewGate: Year-end review must confirm validators, release boundaries, and deferred dangerous actions.

laneRoutines.h1: Refresh source-of-truth status, backlog, review queue, and Command Center lane copy.
laneRoutines.h2: Reconcile generated views, goal records, release notes, and governance evidence before PR closeout.

laneRoutines.h1: Review @seis-cloud target placeholders, dry-run checks, rollback ownership, and SSH-disabled boundaries.
laneRoutines.h2: Harden @seis-cloud deployment readiness docs, incident notes, approval gates, and no-live-action messaging.

laneRoutines.h1: Build the next browser-safe workspace slice with local persistence and clear no-key behavior.
laneRoutines.h2: Add editor, terminal, source-control, and AI REPL QA evidence without exposing provider secrets.

laneRoutines.h1: Inventory components, tokens, motion rules, visual states, and responsive acceptance criteria.
laneRoutines.h2: Run visual QA, accessibility review, reduced-motion review, and asset provenance checks.

laneRoutines.h1: Register new JSON records, schema expectations, freshness rules, and evidence ownership.
laneRoutines.h2: Validate data consumers, stale-state behavior, provenance links, and generated artifact integrity.
